$comment: D-1 phase 3 admission, 2026-11-21 (owner decision: merge panels/autoPanels/backOffice into screens/experiences). One keyword (screens[].panel) whose body is $defs/screenPanel, the old panel body minus `name` (the screen supplies it): 1 + 12 slots. Replaces the removed root key `panels`; the orphaned $defs/panel was dropped from the schema in the same step.

declarative.why: a block of settings for one hand-written panel (route, title, data sources, layout, field bindings, visibility, actions); nothing is computed

notLower.why: a panel is a routed, permission-checked page the author composes from named data sources and layout regions; no expression, function or step can produce one, and kind custom + component only mounts app code

twice.note: every hand-written panel in the samples, the AppGen apps and the built-in packs is declared this way; it replaces the root panels[] key, one-for-one

enforced.note: PanelScreenEquivalenceTest compiles the same app written with the old panels[] shape and with kind custom screens carrying a panel block and asserts the compiled panels are identical; JsonModelParser refuses a root panels key (LEGACY_PANELS_ROOT_KEY)
